summary: Backend testing for Portale SLA v0.11.0-beta (Fase B: Anti Brute-Force). All 15 pytest tests passed: version bump, CSP hCaptcha whitelist, non-regression on core flows, hCaptcha soft-disable + active mode, and rate limits on login (10/min), register (3/hour), reset-password (20/hour), calcola-km (60/hour). 429 responses include Retry-After header and italian detail. HCAPTCHA_SECRET restored to empty and test data cleaned after run.
critical_code_review_comments: core/captcha.py: fail-closed on network error toward hcaptcha.com returns 503 — good UX for legit users but denies-of-service upstream can effectively block registrations. Consider circuit breaker + short-lived cache of last-known-good verify latency.

routes/auth.py: register endpoint sets `secure=True; samesite=none` cookies. In local/HTTP dev these cookies will not persist. Documented behavior, but worth calling out for anyone running behind plain HTTP.
routes/rimborsi.py: no DELETE endpoint for /rimborsi/{id} — expected soft-delete via stato PUT; make sure UX matches this contract (tests were adapted accordingly).
rate_limit.py: uses in-memory Limiter — perfect for the single-Pi deployment target but any horizontal scaling MUST switch to redis storage_uri as noted in the comment.

server.py: RateLimitExceeded handler returns detail as `str(exc.detail)` inside retry_after field but hardcodes `Retry-After: 60` seconds. If a heavier per-hour limit is hit, client is told to retry in 60s but the bucket resets in up to 3600s. Consider computing Retry-After from the actual window.
seed_data_creation: Test users (email prefix 'test_') created and cleaned up automatically by module-scoped autouse fixture. No persistent seed data left. HCAPTCHA_SECRET restored to '' at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limits are in-memory (slowapi) — restarting the backend resets counters. Through Kubernetes ingress, all requests share the same client IP so rate limits are shared across test runs. When testing rate limits, always run rate-limit-consuming tests LAST (order encoded in test file). If you re-run TestRateLimitRegister/Login soon after (within the limit window), first `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` to clear counters. Google Maps quota consumed by TestRateLimitCalcolaKm: ~61 requests per run.

verified_behaviors.CSP header: contains hcaptcha.com in script-src, style-src, connect-src, frame-src
verified_behaviors.hCaptcha soft-disabled: registration without hcaptcha_token succeeds (200) when HCAPTCHA_SECRET=''
verified_behaviors.hCaptcha active — missing token: returns 400 with detail 'Completa il captcha per continuare.'
verified_behaviors.hCaptcha active — dummy test-token: returns 200 (verified against real hcaptcha.com siteverify with test-key)
verified_behaviors.POST /api/auth/login rate limit 10/min: 11th request returns 429 with Retry-After header + italian detail
